title: Billie Eilish Says ‘Hi’ to New Hair Color & Length in Latest Transformation
summary: "Finally I see the resemblance with Finneas," one person commented.
contentText:
Billie Eilish just debuted her latest hair transformation, and some fans think it makes her and brother Finneas look more like birds of a feather.

Related

The pop star shared a mirror selfie capturing her new tresses on Instagram on Monday (Oct. 5), revealing that she’s now sporting a wavy bob with a pale auburn hue. In the snap, she makes a funny face while sitting in what appears to be a dressing room, wearing a simple sweater and khaki-colored trousers.

“hi,” she simply captioned the post, which also features snaps of her dog, Shark, a pumpkin patch and Eilish’s reflection in a different mirror giving fans a peek at the tattoos on her torso.

In the comments, some followers pointed out how Eilish now has the same hair color as her older sibling and longtime collaborator. “Finally I see the resemblance with Finneas,” one person wrote, to which others replied “LOL SAME” and “omg you just helped me see it.”

The two-time Oscar winner is known for changing up her hair. When she first rose to fame in the late 2010s, she was recognizable for her bright silver hair, after which she dyed it blue, then black with neon green roots. During her Happier Than Ever Billboard 200 No. 1 album era in 2021, she wore her hair golden blonde, and throughout her Hit Me Hard and Soft cycle, the star has kept her tresses a dark chocolate brown.

Eilish kept the brunette shade throughout the filming of Sarah Polley’s upcoming adaptation of Sylvia Plath’s The Bell Jar , which wrapped in September. The 10-time Grammy winner plays main character Esther Greenwood in the film, marking her major motion picture debut.
